description: The daemon page router (page-router.md): what each cmux page may call and which subscribe events it hears, and which v2 operation namespaces the daemon routes to an owner outside the operation catalog. The one source: the daemon embeds this file, and bindings/codegen/page_router.py generates the page clients' table from it.

home-channels.description: Channels (Home). It reads conversations through the raw conversation commands of its authenticated WebSocket, and the participants' pictures with participant.avatar.get. A web link the person clicks in the Chief chat opens on the right side of the home workspace with workspace.open_url, only on the person's gesture (a host confirmation on the page relay); its WebSocket has no confirmation, so it is refused there. It manages the person's Chiefs (chief-profile-ws-v1): it lists and reads them and changes display_name, role and the avatar; create, delete, undo, instructions, personality, the lock and the grant (tools, harnesses, engine, self_edit) need the person's gesture; it reads a Chief's kept revisions (chief.profile.history). Its WebSocket keeps its raw subscribe; a page relay of this page gets no event stream.

history.description: History. Reads the merged history; a delete needs the person's gesture (hq-99 rule on cmux#13742); it hears history-changed, so an open page re-reads when history changes.

apps.description: App Store. Reads the catalog and the installed-app panels (grants, logs, icons). Hide/Show and revoking a scope need the person's gesture (they never widen what an app may do); an install, uninstall, allowed scope or other change needs the person's confirmation on a native sheet (never a click alone: a change can turn off an app's sandbox). It hears apps-changed, so an open page shows an install, removal or instance change made elsewhere (the CLI, another window) without a reload.

agent.description: The agent pane, and in it the New Tab page (page id from cmux-page://cmux.agent). It asks the folder trust question of a chat on another machine (cx-1bhjj): it reads the folder's trust, and its answer needs the person's gesture. No other page reads folder trust: it tells a page which folders the person works in.

apps.description: The App Store owner (the app supervisor's store; raw `apps-store {op, args}`). Unix socket and authenticated WebSocket connections; mutations need origin user.

agent_session.description: Folder trust of a chat of this machine (agent-session-trust, commands.md; cx-1bhjj): `agent_session.trust.get {surface, cwd}` answers acpmux's acp.trust.get, `agent_session.trust.set {surface, cwd, level, home_confirmed?}` records an answer (acp.trust.set). The tab must be an agent tab of this store; the machine kind gate and the home folder rule of agent-session-start apply, and a page never sends home_confirmed (it cannot prove the person chose the home folder first). Unix socket only (a WebSocket page gets agent_session.not_trusted); a set needs origin user. The call runs on the relay's connection (one relay connection per pane).
